jobs.name: stand
jobs.prompt: Each robed cultist now stands still in place facing right, both feet planted together on the same ground line, body upright and calm, head slightly bowed in quiet prayer. The free hand is raised to the chest in a praying gesture. Keep every held prop (torch, scroll, staff, walking stick, lantern, reliquary, banner, bag) in the same hand. Keep identity, robe colors, hood, glowing eyes, size, position and pixel art style exactly the same.
jobs.note: One 9-frame edit; frame N is follower N's standing pose and the first frame of both of its loops. Frames 0, 1, 2, 6 and 7 came back with feet at y=64 and are shifted down 4px when strips are assembled.

jobs.name: follower-0-idle
jobs.action: A seamless looping idle prayer in place, facing right: the cultist stands still and breathes slowly, shoulders rising and falling gently, head bowed in quiet prayer, robe swaying slightly. Preserve the exact character identity, outfit, colors, held props and pixel art style. Props stay in the same hand. Feet stay planted on the same ground line. No walking, turning, camera movement or scenery. End on the starting pose.

jobs.name: follower-0-pray
jobs.action: A seamless looping reverent prayer at an altar, facing right: the cultist slowly leans forward from the waist in reverent prayer with head lowered and the free hand at the chest, pauses, then rises back upright to the starting pose. Preserve the exact character identity, outfit, colors, held props and pixel art style. Props stay in the same hand. Feet stay planted on the same ground line. No walking, turning, weapons, camera movement or scenery. End on the starting pose.
